checkpoint_resume: Frozen run_cell validates and reuses completed task checkpoints; unsaved task work is repeated and retained in attempt logs

cse_execution.cost_scope: Parent, wrapper and raw timings are nested, not additive. Local CUDA and HPC A100 costs are not hardware-matched.

disclosure: Sealed until all seven reference five-seed groups complete; no CSE18 tuning

identity.calibration_prior_role: Original complete prepared TRAIN labels before permanent holdout or smoke subsampling; no TEST role

effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aimagelab/mammoth/e75a491c69fd729edeb01431afb753d9157d9a81/models/config/derpp.yaml (seq-cifar100, buffer500); transferred fixed coefficients, not NIDS-tuned

publication_derivation.changes: Only private absolute roots in command/path metadata are normalized; original identity and all original numeric values are unchanged. raw_result_sha256 binds the sanitized copy; original_raw_result_sha256 preserves the original binding.
publication_derivation.checkpoint_reference_base: checkpoint_file is unchanged and resolves against the original result directory, not this publication directory; weights are not exported.

calibration.prior_role: Original complete prepared TRAIN labels before permanent holdout or smoke subsampling; no TEST role

protocol.finite_sample_limit: FP <= floor(alpha * calibration_count); strict Normal prior maximum and nonincreasing observed FP required
protocol.limitation: The permanent pool was available to allocation validation; it is not a fresh independent calibration sample
protocol.pool: Same seed-specific permanent Normal TRAIN holdout for every method; never optimized
protocol.replay_la: Same Replay weights and total tau; baseline tau=1 plus delta, no extra training or inference
protocol.rule: First adjacent initial-grid bracket when present; otherwise expand toward the missing infeasible lower or feasible upper endpoint; retain feasible upper endpoint after 50 bisections
protocol.test_role: Evaluate selected total tau only; test metrics never select tau or the expansion range
